■Notice of Supply Drop Lineup “SUMO Gold Type”
Supply Drop Lineup has been updated.
■Period
■Unit
・★★★ SUMO Gold Type LV1 (General unit, ground/space uses, cost: 700)
※The above MS is eligible for the Monthly MS Bonus Unit.
■Mobile Suit Features
・General unit with cost of 700.
・A high-performance MS piloted by Harry Ord, the Captain of the Royal Guard,
serving directly under the Moon Queen, Dianna Soriel.
・As a result of the military conflict between the Moon Race and the Earth forces,
the Earth’s surface was buried under nanomachines,
wiping out all traces of civilization and bringing the final war to an end.
The Moon Race was forced to retreat back to the lunar surface
and endure long years of living on the Moon.
As a result, the only combat MS developed and deployed to the Royal Guard were these units,
the SUMO Gold Type and the standard SUMO Silver Type.
・This unit basically shares the same specs as the SUMO Silver Type,
but features superior armor and head unit performance.
Its main drive system is the I-Field Beam Drive (IFBD),
which generates I-Field beams from within the machine
and spreads them across its surface to control and power the unit.
It excels in high-mobility combat utilizing its FRP (Field Repulsion Processor).
Furthermore, its Helical Phase-Type Hyper-Vibrational Gauge Field Collapse Power Generator
is capable of inducing the shutdown of units equipped with I-Field Beam Drive,
giving it performance befitting its role as a Queen’s guardian.
・Can be deployed both on the Ground and in Space.
※This video may not be representative of the actual product.
※Please also make sure to have a check to the event schedule so that you will not miss anything.

・When staggered, heavily staggered, or toppled by an enemy attack,
the type of damage taken just before that will be temporarily reduced.
・Note that this skill does not apply to reactions from certain types of attacks,
such as fixed damage, tackles, and counters.

・Support unit with cost of 600.
・This mass-production Geara Zulu variant replaced the Geara Doga
as the main MS employed by Neo Zeon remnants known as the Sleeves.
・It was originally being developed as the next-generation mainstay MS for Neo Zeon Forces,
but that plan was put on hold once Char’s Rebellion had concluded.
However, when mass production plans were resurrected by the Sleeves,
its design was revised, ultimately making it into a variant of the Geara Doga
with emphasis placed on productivity, operability, and expandability.
・Meanwhile, although Federation Forces were downsizing militarily,
they maintained sufficient combat strength
centered on such units as active-duty Jegans and cutting-edge ReZELs.
In response, the Sleeves took advantage of multipurpose retrofitting,
allowing them to conduct guerrilla-style operations and tactics
without needing to maintain multiple MS types specialized in different areas.
・This unit in particular was piloted by Cuarón Masuka,
a member of Full Frontal’s personal guard unit.
It is equipped with a beam sniper rifle specialized for long-range sniping.
・Can be deployed both on the Ground and in Space.

■Overview of “GBO DAYS”
Several events will be held from every first Thursday through Sunday as our campaign "GBO Days"!
■What is GBO Days?
GBO Days is a special monthly campaign that will start at the first Thursday of every month
at 17:00 until the next Monday 04:59 .
Pilots who always play GBO2 will receive a lot of benefits, furthermore,
new and returning pilots will be even benefited from some of the content during the campaign!
■GBO Days November Schedule
■Campaign Details

①Free "Guaranteed Mobile Suit Supply Drops" that can be requested once a day! (Up to 4 Units!)
②"Special Supply Drop" with 2 guaranteed ★★★ or higher rarity MS can be requested once!
(10 Times/30 Tokens)
③Basic rewards (EXP, DP, CP) after battle will be doubled!
If you are a new or returning pilot, it will be increased to 5 times!
④New & returning pilots always have a 100% container discovery rate of the recon team!
Also, veteran pilots of GBO2 who sortie with, new & returning pilots,
their observation unit's container discovery rate will be increased by 30%!
※New pilots must start up GBO2 for the first time and click "GAME START" on the title screen within 14 days.
※Returning pilots are those who have not logged in for at least 45 days since the last logged out of GBO2.
※Please note that basic rewards will not be increased
if pilot has started a game session after the campaign period.
※The number of containers that can be found will be only two per day.
※If you have been awarded with Premium War Merit badge,
the number of containers you can find per day will be increased.
※Date will be updated daily at 5:00 AM .

the Crossbone Gundam X1’s exceptional mobility

which can be used effectively to achieve favorable combat results.

This unit was used in Operation Steel 7 to counter the attack.
・Its frame, featuring built-in thrusters for explosive acceleration,
was lined with all remaining ABC cloaks (anti-beam coating cloaks) for extra protection.
This, combined with shoulder armor that is equipped with four X-3 I-Field generators,
provided the unit with remarkable anti-beam resistance.
Such robust defenses made it possible for a small squadron of these units
to cut through a large contingent of enemy forces.
・Can be deployed both on the Ground and in Space.
※This video may not be representative of the actual product.

and reduces the amount of thruster consumed while moving at high speed.
・Damage reactions caused by ranged attacks received during melee attacks are nullified
and incoming damage is reduced.

■Mobile Suit Features
・Raid unit with cost of 750.
・The third unit of the Crossbone Gundam series,
supplied to the Crossbone Vanguard space pirates by Buch Concern.
・The Crossbone Gundam is an experimental prototype unit based on the F9 series concept,
equipped with four large movable thrusters on its back,
allowing it to freely alter its mobility vectors to cope with the Jupiter Sphere’s high gravity.
・Although there is no difference in performance compared to the X1 or X2, features like an additional
Gatling Cannon positioned inside its thickened chest armor emphasize close-combat capabilities.
・For defensive purposes, it is equipped with I-Field generators that are highly effective
against battleship-class beam attacks.
For offensive purposes it wields the Muramasa Blaster, which not only fires beams
but also generates 14 beam sabers along its sword-like edge for powerful melee combat,
making it exceptional in both offense and defense.
However, despite its remarkable effectiveness, there are risks associated with its limited operation time,
making it a highly difficult unit to operate.
・Can be deployed both on the Ground and in Space.
※This video may not be representative of the actual product.
※Please also make sure to have a check to the event schedule so that you will not miss anything.
Skill “Max Output (T)”
・When dealing damage to an enemy MS with a melee weapon, the Skill Gauge increases.
Pressing "special weapon" when the skill gauge is full activates the skill,
granting the following effects for a set duration.
・Fully recovers HP for all parts (head, back, legs) while activation
・Increases unit attack power, mobility
・Damage taken from melee attacks is reduced
・The upper limit of high-speed movement speed increases,
thruster consumption when initiating high-speed movement and during high-speed movement is reduced
・Performance for weapons compatible with the skill is altered
This skill can be used again after some time has passed.
Skill “Heavy Attack Kai”
・When selecting a weapon that supports this skill,
hold and release the attack button to perform a melee attack with added power.
・Increases the attack power and close combat accuracy
・Negates enemy MS’s “Special Cushioning” skill
・Even when hitting an enemy MS’s shield weaponry, deals damage to the MS itself
・During Heavy Attack, reduces damage taken when attacked, damage reaction,
and stagger caused by accumulated damage
・Also, Heavy Attack can be used while in midair
Sub-weapon “X-3 I-Field Generator”
・Temporarily generates an arm I-Field,
which reduces HP damage from beam attacks and reduces or nullifies reactions.
Reactions from cumulative beam attacks are reduced as well.
・If this weapon is selected while its arm I-Field is activated, and ranged beam attacks are taken from the front,
cumulative damage reactions from those attacks are nullified.
・Also compatible with the Max Output (T) skill, extending the weapon’s effect time during max output.
・However, changing to melee and exiting during a tackle will cause the I-Field to vanish, resulting in overheating.

■MAPs
◎some MAPs have been adjusted
Deserted City
Adjustment ①: New buildings added to the central battlefield
⇒ The central area, which serves as the main battlefield, was generally an open space,
making it difficult to approach enemy units.
Therefore, we have added new tall buildings to serve as cover.
Adjustment ②: Added cover around Relay Points E and F
⇒ Relay points E and F were both located in open areas without any cover,
making it particularly difficult to secure them during high-cost battles.
Therefore, we have added new structures to serve as cover.
◎Relay point E
◎Relay point F
Military Port
Adjustment ①: New route added for advancing toward the base
⇒ Until now, advancing toward the base required either making a large detour along the outer edge of the map
to use a slope, or jumping over the ledge in front of the base, which made it difficult to launch an attack.
To address this, we have added a slope in front of the base.
Adjustment ②: Water transparency adjusted for ground-level perspective
⇒ With the addition of the slope making it easier to advance toward the base, we have increased
the water’s surface transparency when viewed from the ground to make it easier to see underwater activity,
in order to prevent the defending side from being put at too much of a disadvantage.
Adjustment③: Adjusted water depth
⇒ This map features significant elevation differences between the ground and underwater areas,
making it difficult to attack in either direction due to firing angle limitations.
To address this, we have raised the overall depth of the underwater areas.
City Ruins
Adjustment ①: Added a new route that allows traversal through the dome
⇒ The dome located at the center of the map had limited entry routes, which often led to a stalemate in battles.
To address this, we have added new entry routes into the dome.
Adjustment ②: Relocated the Type 61 tank
⇒ The Type 61 tanks positioned near relay points C and D were obstructing movement during mobile suit combat,
so we have adjusted their placement.
Ravine
Adjustment ①: Modified the shape of the central high ground
⇒ This map tended to result in a stalemate due to long-range firefights in the central area,
so we have modified the shape of the central high ground to allow players to advance while taking cover.
Adjustment ②: Added a new route from the central area into the waterways
⇒ We have created an opening in the cliff that separates the central area and the waterways,
adding a new route to relay points A and B.
Additionally, since there was previously only one exit from the waterways,
we have added a branch to create a second exit.
◎Modified the shape of the cliff
◎Added a branch to the waterway
⇒ In addition, various minor adjustments to terrain shapes have been made throughout the map.
■Others
◎Added an operator list screen and a voice preview feature.
⇒ Added a list screen to the operator selection, allowing for more visual overview
of the operators and the ability to preview their voices.
You can access it by highlighting “Operator” under “H.A.R.O. > Options > Sound Settings”

■Fixes
◎MAPs
・In “Mining City”, we’ve fixed certain objects and textures that were being displayed abnormally.
・In “Mining City”, we’ve fixed an area where MSs were unable to land and would continuously fall
for an extended period.
・In “Resort Development District”, we’ve fixed an issue where tank-type MS would get unnaturally stuck
on the rooftops of buildings near the base.
・In “Colony Drop Area”, we’ve fixed an area where mobile suits (MS) were unable to land
and would continuously fall for an extended period.
◎Units
・In “ReZEL”, we’ve fixed an issue where the sound effect would sometimes not being played when using
the ranged main weapon “ReZEL Beam Rifle”.
・In “Heavygun”, we’ve corrected the unit description when the language is set to English.
・In “Engage Zero Yonfavin”, we’ve corrected the spelling of weapon names when the language is set to English.
◎Skills
・For the skill “Max Performance”, we’ve fixed an issue where performing certain actions would incorrectly increase
the activation count from pilot kills.
・For the skills “Close Combat Program” and “Overfeed”, we’ve fixed an issue where,
under certain conditions of damage reactions from attacks
by opponents using the “High Speed Mobile Shooting” skill were not being properly reduced.
・For the skill “Close Combat Program”, we’ve added text to the description regarding the shield-equipped weapons.
■After the change
If a melee weapon is equipped when hit by a ranged attack, mobility is increased while the stagger is reduced.
However, when a shield weapon is selected, the skill will not activate.
◎Battles
・Fixed an issue where, under certain conditions of no damage reaction would occur when taking attacks
during high-speed movement in midair.
・In beam shield-type weapons, fixed an issue where performing an attack at the moment the weapon overheats
would result in no hit detection occurring, despite the attack animation occuring.
◎Weapons
・In beam shield-type weapons, we’ve fixed unclear wording in the weapon description.
This fix does not affect the performance of the weapon.
■Before
If the shield is fired on while activated, damage taken is reduced.
■Now
If the shield is fired on while activated, damage dealt to Shield HP is reduced.
◎Hangars
・In the Hangar, we’ve fixed an issue where the cursor would sometimes appear in an unnatural position
when displaying the MS list from various facilities.
◎Others
・In the H.A.R.O. menu, when first accessing the ‘MS > Favorite MS/Badges’ screen,
we’ve added a guide for the target value regarding COST 750, which was previously missing.
The latest information will be posted on STEAM News and our X (Twitter) in the future.
We look forward to your continued support of "Mobile Suit Gundam Battle Operation 2".

damage is dealt according to the HP of remaining enemy units.
・When using the skill “Large Utility Binder” and receive an attack with no damage reaction, the “RESIST” message
would appear even if there was no damage reaction to mitigate the damage which is now fixed.

“Sekiha Tenkyoken, there was an issue where the effect that partially invalidates the opponent's
“melee resistance” (which activates when using a melee weapon) did not trigger, which is now fixed.

where it was possible to attack in the air by performing certain operations, which is now fixed.
◎Others
・An issue was occurring at Hangar where the number of recycle tickets not being used at the facility
was being displayed and now is fixed.

⇒ Due to the overall darkness of the map,
effects such as explosions and beams were perceived to be too blinding, so the brightness is now adjusted.
⇒ The high ground to the east and west of the MAP was too favorable for defense,
so the shape of the cliffs was adjusted to easier for both offensive and defensive fire lines to pass through.
⇒ The terrain around the center of the MAP was difficult to pass through due to the lack of cover,
so debris and other objects are now newly placed.
・Impact site
⇒ The high ground near the defender base was shaped to favor the attacker,
making it difficult for the defender to regain control of the base when it was attacked,
so it is now shaped to make it easier for the defender to climb up.

⇒ Other terrain in the MAP where the MS would get stuck or land unnaturally is now adjusted.

that can be passed through on the ground.

Recommended for Raid units that frequently use thrusters and for high-LV units with variable functions.

Since the Maximum of the ballistic resistance can be increased,

When equipped on a unit equipped with a large number of Psycommu armaments,
